metadata.description: Pre-generated LLM briefings for 2023 McDougall Creek fire demo scenario
metadata.notes: Keyed by profile flag string. 'default' is the baseline (no flags set). Regenerate with backend/scripts/generate_demo_briefings.py when LLM prompt changes.

briefings.default: Fire is 7.4 km from your address. At current wind speed (42 km/h NE), the projected boundary reaches your area in approximately 4.2 hours. Evacuate south via Hwy 97 S to Royal LePage Place — 5.8 km, about 8 minutes. Avoid Westside Road and Bear Creek Road, both closed due to fire activity.
